Connecting Jobs, run by the non-profit organization Beredskapslyftet, supports newcomers in taking their first steps into the Swedish labour market – while at the same time helping employers access new talent.
We are now looking for a Furniture and Fine Carpenter for a Stockholm-based company that provides complete solutions for commercial environments, mainly hotels, restaurants and specialised offices. The company covers the whole project, from concept development and design proposals to construction and interior work.
Location:
Stockholm (work at different locations in Stockholm County)
Who we are looking for:
Furniture and Fine Carpenter (Fineworks Carpenter)
Responsibilities:
Carrying out furniture making and fine carpentry work with high quality and precision
Repairing, maintaining and improving furniture and wooden details
Taking part in carpentry work related to interiors and wooden boats
Handling materials, tools and machinery in a safe and professional way
Helping with practical tasks and general maintenance when needed

Requirements:
You can understand instructions and communicate clearly in Swedish or English
You have experience in furniture making, fine carpentry or a similar trade. Relevant vocational training or equivalent practical experience is also valued
You have good knowledge of wood, materials, construction and different carpentry techniques
You can work with precision and achieve a high-quality finish
You have a valid driving licence (Category B)
You are ready to work at different locations in Stockholm County
Experience in interior work, furniture restoration or wooden boats is an advantage

Your profile:
You have a genuine interest in craftsmanship and take pride in your work
You are practical, solution-oriented and pay attention to detail
You are careful, responsible and able to work independently
You take initiative and aim for a high-quality result
You are flexible, easy to work with and comfortable with a variety of tasks

What the employer offers:
Full-time job
Employment with a probation period, with the possibility of permanent employment

Important: This position is part of a project that is co-funded by the European Union through the Asylum, Migration and Integration Fund (AMIF). The project aims to support third-country nationals in their integration into the Swedish labor market. The participants hold residence permits in Sweden but do not have Swedish citizenship or EU/EEA citizenship.

Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity:
 As a Tactical Commercial Manager within BCSS, you are the key commercial partner between Business Area and Market Area teams, helping translate commercial strategy into successful customer deals.
 You will work closely with Sales, Commercial and Pricing teams to shape deal strategy, guide commercial decisions and ensure consistent execution of BCSS pricing and commercial models. Combining strategic thinking with operational execution, you will influence deal outcomes, drive commercial discipline and act as a trusted advisor across the organization.
 This role is ideal for an experienced commercial professional who enjoys building relationships, solving complex business challenges and driving continuous improvement in a dynamic global environment.
  
 What you will do:
  Partner with Market Area Sales, Commercial and Pricing teams to shape commercially successful deals aligned with BCSS strategy.
 Build trusted relationships and act as the commercial advisor to BA Heads of Sales and key stakeholders.
 Serve as the operational bridge between Business Area and Market Area teams, balancing business objectives while enabling effective collaboration.
 Drive commercial discipline by promoting standardized pricing approaches, commercial models, pricing parameters and best practices.
 Develop deep expertise in the commercial environment, pricing levels and market dynamics across your assigned geographies and customers.
 Own delegated commercial approvals and provide recommendations for escalations and complex commercial decisions.
 Challenge existing ways of working and drive continuous improvements that strengthen commercial performance.
 Contribute to strategic initiatives, share expertise across the Tactical Commercial Management team and coach colleagues on commercial excellence.
  
 
 The skills you bring:
  Extensive experience in sales, pricing or commercial management, with a strong understanding of deal strategy and commercial negotiations.
 Ability to influence and build trusted partnerships across Business Area and Market Area organizations.
 Strong commercial acumen with the ability to understand the full commercial picture and balance customer, market and business priorities.
 A proactive, innovative and solution-oriented mindset with the confidence to challenge constructively and drive change.
 Resilience and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-impact environment while managing competing priorities.
 Strong knowledge of Ericsson pricing methodologies, commercial models and supporting tools.
 Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.
 Minimum 5 years of sales and commercial experience.

We are seeking a Mechanical/Electrical Design Engineer with expertise in CAD design, simulation, and compliance to join our team at ALTEN Sweden in Örebro. In this role, you will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to develop, test, and optimize mechanical and electrical systems for clients in industries such as manufacturing, engineering, and life sciences.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
As a consultant at ALTEN, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging and exciting projects with some of our key clients, with:
Technical challenges and development opportunities.
An inspiring community and the chance to contribute to a sustainable future.
Supportive and coaching leadership.
The possibility to work across various industries where our clients operate.
A personal training budget for internal or external courses.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Creating and refining mechanical and electrical designs using CAD tools (e.g., AutoCAD, Creo).
Performing schematic design and component selection for electrical systems.
Ensuring designs comply with international standards (e.g., IEC, IEEE, ISO) and regulatory requirements for safety and efficiency.
Running simulations (e.g., MATLAB, Teamcenter) to validate designs and improve performance.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to manage projects from concept to completion.

Qualifications:
Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields.
Fluent in English
Minimum 1 years of hands-on experience in electrical system design, testing, or troubleshooting.
Swedish is a strong advantage

ABOUT ALTEN
ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies, with over 57,000 employees across approximately 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the entire product development chain for leading companies in several industries including Automotive, Defense & Security, Energy, Industrial Equipment, Public Sector, and Life Sciences.
In Sweden, we are approximately 1,300 dedicated employees spread across 9 offices in cities ranging from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.
For the fifth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden’s most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen for five consecutive years — an award for companies offering unique career and development opportunities.
Welcome to read more about us at alten.se

We are looking for an Electrical Design Engineer with expertise in low-voltage systems design, testing, and troubleshooting to join ALTEN Sweden. In this role, you will focus on creating wiring diagrams, cable designs, and ensuring compliance with international and Swedish electrical standards. You will work closely with installation teams and clients in industries such as industrial automation, building electrical systems, and sustainable infrastructure.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
As a consultant at ALTEN, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging and exciting projects with some of our key clients, with:
Technical challenges and development opportunities.
An inspiring community and the chance to contribute to a sustainable future.
Supportive and coaching leadership.
The possibility to work across various industries where our clients operate.
A personal training budget for internal or external courses.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Design and develop detailed wiring diagrams for low-voltage systems (e.g., lighting, fire alarm, security, automation).
Perform cable calculations (cross-sectional area, insulation type, derating factors) using tools like ETAP or DIgSILENT.
Ensure all designs comply with IEC 60364, NEC (NFPA 70), SS 424, and ELSÄK-FS 2023:1 standards.
Select appropriate cable types (e.g., NYY, JY(St)Y, Cat6) and design cable routing, shielding, and grounding.
Collaborate with installation teams to verify diagram accuracy and cable suitability.
Optimize designs for sustainability (LEED/BREEAM certification is a plus).

Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
Fluent in English
2+ years in low-voltage wiring diagram creation and cable design (power, control, or communication cables).
Swedish is a strong advantage

jobs.occupation: Advance Your Internal Medicine Career in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
At Dignus Medical, we specialize in matching experienced specialists in internal medicine with high-quality career opportunities throughout Sweden. Whether you are looking for a smaller hospital setting or a larger multidisciplinary clinic, we tailor the opportunity to your experience, interests, and ambitions.
We are currently seeking EU-certified specialists in internal medicine for permanent roles within hospitals and medical centers across Sweden.
You will be involved in diagnosing and managing a wide spectrum of conditions related to internal organ systems – often working both in inpatient wards and outpatient clinics. Our clients include both regional and university-affiliated hospitals, and many positions offer opportunities to combine general internal medicine with a subspecialty (e.g. cardiology, rheumatology, nephrology, etc.).
What we offer
Permanent employment with stable and supportive workplaces
Competitive salaries and favorable working hours
Structured onboarding, relocation assistance, and integration support
Personal follow-up and guidance throughout the process
Free language training with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Requirements
EU-recognized specialist certification in internal medicine, equivalent to Swedish standards
Good communication skills in English
Willingness to learn Swedish – full support provided
Motivation to develop professionally in a new healthcare system

Why Choose Dignus Medical?
We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.
Interested in a career in Sweden?
Let’s talk! Contact us today to learn more about current openings or submit your application. We look forward to helping you take the next step in your internal medicine career.
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: SAP Process Expert  Transportation Management (SAP TM) - 20968
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for an experienced SAP Process Expert in Transportation Management to support a global SAP S/4HANA transformation.
You will be part of the Logistics Capability team, connecting business transportation and logistics requirements with SAP Transportation Management (SAP TM) and other SAP modules.
You will contribute to the design, implementation, testing and validation of business logistics processes across the entire transportation flow, including data management and Organizational Change Management (OCM).
What You Will Work On
Lead SAP TM process workshops and translate business needs into processes, requirements, business scenarios and use cases.
Support transportation planning, freight unit creation, carrier selection and transport order management.
Work with carrier networks, transport zones, routes, tendering and freight procurement.
Support inbound and outbound logistics processes.
Coordinate integrations across Sales, Service, Manufacturing, Warehouse Management and Transportation Management.
Work with freight costing, rate calculations, freight agreements, settlement and cost allocation.
Support shipment tracking, exception management, KPIs and logistics performance monitoring.
Manage transportation master data, including carriers, transport zones and routes.
Define and validate tests, including ITC and UAT.
Collaborate with Warehouse Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, Sales, Customs, Finance and Service teams.
Contribute to transportation planning decisions, carrier collaboration and governance.
Track requirements, gaps, risks, issues and improvement actions.
Ensure SAP solutions meet business requirements.

What You Bring
Strong experience with SAP Transportation Management (SAP TM).
Experience in transportation and logistics processes.
Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA.
Understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes.
Experience from large transformation, harmonization or implementation projects.
Ability to take ownership of a process area and proactively identify issues.
Structured approach and ability to work with changing requirements.
Strong communication skills in Swedish and English.

Meritorious
Experience with SAP EWM, SD, MM and LE.
Experience with freight procurement, carrier integration and freight settlement.
Experience with inbound and outbound logistics processes.
Experience with SAP testing, including ITC and UAT.
Experience with data management and Organizational Change Management (OCM).

Your role
 
We're looking for a System Analyst - Pricing Systems & Strategy who enjoys combining data, systems, and business insights to improve pricing decisions and profitability.
 
In this role, you'll play a key part in translating our pricing strategy into scalable system solutions, ensuring high pricing quality, and identifying opportunities to optimize performance across our global business. You'll collaborate with stakeholders across business, IT, and pricing teams to continuously improve our pricing landscape.
 
What you'll do:
Own and develop our pricing system landscape, including Syncron Price and related solutions.
Translate business needs into system requirements and development priorities.
Drive the implementation of divisional pricing strategies through data-driven analysis and optimization.
Monitor pricing quality, identify exceptions and trends, and recommend improvement actions.
Develop pricing methodologies, business rules, and reporting to support better decision-making.
Ensure pricing data, controls, and governance processes support consistency and business value.

Your skills and experience
You probably have experience in a similar role where you've combined systems, data, and business understanding.
 
We're particularly interested in candidates who bring:
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with business systems, ERP platforms, BI tools, or pricing solutions.
An interest in pricing, profitability, data quality, and process improvement.
The ability to collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders.
Professional proficiency in English.

 
Meriting:
Syncron Price, SAP, Power BI, or similar platforms.
Pricing, aftermarket, service, or industrial business environments.
Data-driven optimization and profitability analysis.

Your job location
This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site in our office in Stockholm, Sweden (SE).
Why it is great to work with us
You'll have the opportunity to influence how pricing decisions are made across a global organization, working at the intersection of business strategy, analytics, and technology. If you're motivated by solving complex problems, driving improvements, and creating business impact, we'd love to hear from you.
Application process
Our selection process includes interviews, skills assessments and a background check. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us.

Join a supportive, forward-thinking team at our customer where you will drive end-to-end Performance Management and data mediation, turning raw network metrics into reliable KPIs for fixed networks.
About the role
In this role, you will own and evolve the PM data pipelines connecting fixed-network devices and OSS to the target platform. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, explainable data for both operations and business decisions.
This is initially a consulting assignment where you will be employed by Academic Work and work as a consultant for our client, with a good possibility of extension. 
Work tasks
This role involves developing, operating, and integrating data pipelines to optimize network performance management and observability.
Develop and operate robust data ingestion and transformation flows to OPTIC Data Lake and NNMi/NOM.  
Integrate with adjacent systems like inventory, ITSM, and analytics using APIs and message queues.  
Collaborate with Solution Architects, Product Owners, and Performance Analysts to prioritize value.  
Onboard new data sources and extend metric models to reduce vendor dependence.

We are looking for
Knowledge of Python and SQL
Basic knowledge of ETL/ELT frameworks and job orchestration
Basic knowledge of SNMP (MIBs, polling), traps, and streaming telemetry
Experience in working with data pipelines in OSS, telecom PM, or network analytics
Fluent in English

It is meritorious if you have
Experience with enterprise NMS/OSS platforms (e.g., OpenText/Micro Focus, IBM, or similar) and data lake architectures
Good knowledge of DevOps practices
Good knowledge of message buses like Kafka and observability stacks like Grafana, Prometheus, or ELK
Knowledge of Swedish

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Stable
Orderly
Responsible

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Company: WANVE Sweden AB
 Location: Stockholm, Sweden
Job Description
We are looking for motivated and responsible Vehicle Test Drivers to join our team in Sweden.
In this role, you will participate in vehicle testing activities, including test driving, vehicle performance evaluation, and road testing under various driving conditions.
You will work closely with engineering teams to support automotive testing projects in Sweden and other European countries.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct vehicle test driving according to predefined test plans and project requirements.
Perform road testing under different driving conditions and environments.
Monitor vehicle behaviour, performance, and functionality during testing.
Record test observations and report any abnormalities or technical issues.
Support engineers in vehicle testing and validation activities.
Perform basic vehicle inspections before and after testing.
Follow all traffic regulations, safety requirements, and testing procedures.
Participate in vehicle testing projects across Europe when required.

Requirements
Excellent English communication skills, both spoken and written.
Valid BE, C, or CE driving license (at least one of these categories is required).
Strong interest in vehicle testing and willingness to work in automotive testing projects.
Responsible driving behaviour and strong awareness of road safety.
Ability to follow technical instructions and testing procedures.
Willingness and ability to travel to other European countries according to project needs. Business trips typically last no longer than one month per assignment.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Flexible, reliable, and able to work independently.

Preferred Qualifications
Previous experience in vehicle testing, professional driving, or the automotive industry.
Experience driving different types of vehicles, including passenger cars, commercial vehicles, or heavy-duty vehicles.
Basic knowledge of vehicle systems and automotive technology.
Experience working in international environments.

Personal Qualities
We are looking for someone who is:
Safety-conscious, responsible, and detail-oriented.
Enthusiastic about vehicles and driving.
Flexible and willing to adapt to different testing environments.
Patient and capable of following structured testing procedures.
Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.

How to Apply
Please submit your CV and a brief introduction highlighting your driving experience, driving license categories, and relevant qualifications.
We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Dignus Medical connects family medicine specialists with long-term GP jobs across Sweden. We specialize in matching your medical qualifications and personal preferences with clinics and healthcare providers that value your contribution and support your professional development.
We are currently looking for EU-certified specialists in family medicine whose qualifications align with the Swedish GP specialty.
About the position
We offer permanent roles at primary care centers and medical clinics throughout Sweden. As a general practitioner, you will be a key point of contact for patients and play an essential role in early diagnosis, treatment, and the long-term management of both chronic and acute conditions.
Whether you are drawn to smaller communities or urban environments, we will help you find a position that fits your lifestyle and career goals.
What we offer
Permanent employment with public or private clinics
Competitive salary and balanced working hours
Relocation support for you and your family
Language training and integration support
Full assistance throughout the recruitment and onboarding process

Requirements
EU-recognized specialist qualification in family medicine or general practice, equivalent to Swedish standards
Good communication skills in English
Willingness to learn Swedish (language course provided)
Team-oriented and patient-focused approach
Motivation to build a long-term career in Swedish primary care

Why choose Dignus Medical?
With over 20 years of experience in international medical recruitment, Dignus Medical is a trusted partner for doctors seeking permanent GP jobs in Sweden. We guide you through every step of the process, from your first interview to your relocation and integration, ensuring a smooth transition and a sustainable career in Swedish healthcare.
Interested in learning more?
We’d love to hear from you. Submit your application or contact us today to explore current openings.
Let us help you take the next step in your career as a general practitioner in Sweden!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Female personal assistant for 40% (Hammarby Sjöstad) Fixed 1 year position.
jobs.description:
The Ms team is looking for you! 
 
We are an English-speaking team that works in shifts to take care of a disabled 58-year-old man with multiple sclerosis. He lives with his American wife and eleven-year-old daughter in Hammarby Sjöstad. Because of the MS, he needs assistance in almost everything in his daily life ans personal care. 
 
He is a novelist, and you will spend most days writing together as he writes books in English. You will help him bring them to life by typing what he dictates. His life revolves around his family first; he has a positive view of life and a good sense of humor. 
 
We are seeking you who are:

Female (team is all female)
Have a valid work permit and Bank-ID.
Fun and easy to work with.
Detail-oriented but at the same time able to see the big picture. 
Adapt easily and enjoy providing outstanding service. 
Proactive and can take initiative. 
Likes to laugh, has a good sense of humor.   
160 cm or taller.
Easily reachable on a smart phone.
A non-smoker. 
(Speaking and writing Swedish is considered a merit, but not essential.)

About the job: 
· Start from as soon as possible.
·  This is a one‑year fixed‑term position.
·  We work in shifts.
·  We will provide all the necessary training.
.  We are seeking someone who can work around 40% on a schedule (both days and nights) and can take extra shifts from time to time when needed but especially around the holidays. 
 
Majority of the shifts are for nights: 16.00-07.00 (with 7 sleeping hours) but you will also be be needed day time 07:00-16:00 and need to be working every other weekend. 

If you email you application. Name it: "Hammarby-Sjöstad 2611 40%".

About the company,
Fri Assistans is a company that provides personal assistance for our clients around the Stockholm area. We have 24 clients and about 220 employees. To provide a great assistance for our clients we need to have employees that are enjoy their work. Our ambition is always to be the best possibly employer, hoping to build long term relationships with both clients and employees. You are very welcome to become a part of our company!

Job DescriptionAs ITSM Process and Tool manager in Arelion, you will be accountable for effective ITSM processes and an ITSM platform that enable consistent incident, problem, change, and request management. The role aligns process governance, tool configuration, integrations, access, reporting, and continual improvement to reliable service delivery and evolving business needs.Arelion operates a complex IT environment consisting of a DC/IaaS hybrid running a variety of applications, both COTS and in-house developed. We depend on highly skilled people in Arelion and within our support partners to be able to follow efficient processes every day to keep lights. They need the best possible tooling to join forces to solve incidents, investigate complex problems, and handle planned changes. This is where the ITSM Process and Tool manager can make a big difference. You will take over a working foundation, govern it over time, and improve to facilitate even better collaboration and increase efficiency. ​Job RequirementsAt least five years of relevant IT service, operations, support, or ITSM experience in a managed-service environment
Strong practical knowledge of ITIL processes and experience delivering service quality within an ITIL framework
Experience administering and configuring ITSM platforms (preferably Freshservice), including workflows, access roles, integrations, dashboards, and reports to facilitate efficient ways of working with incidents, problems, and changes.
Understanding of IT infrastructure, operating systems, AWS, data centre technologies, VMware, CMDB, monitoring, and asset-management concepts
Strong written and spoken English, stakeholder communication, vendor coordination, planning, organisation, and structured problem-solving
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with ITIL Foundation certification beneficial
Job ResponsibilitiesGovern and improve Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management processes within the ITIL framework
Maintain and configure the ITSM platform to support approved service-management processes and workflows
Align forms, workflows, dashboards, and reports with organisational and stakeholder needs
Manage platform roles, permissions, and access controls for secure and appropriate use
Coordinate integration of the ITSM platform with monitoring, CMDB, asset-management, event/alarm sources, and other relevant systems
Monitor process and tool performance, service-level compliance, and data quality, and address identified issues
Collaborate with infrastructure, application, engineering, support, service-delivery, and supplier stakeholders
Maintain clear process, configuration, and operating documentation
Identify and implement opportunities to simplify, standardise, and optimise IT service management
Job BenefitsAnnual performance/KPI based bonus
ATK - work time shortening
Wellness contribution
Pension plan

Work description:
We are looking for a Cloud Platform & DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of experience to own the infrastructure, security and automation of our AWS Virtual Engineering Workbench (VEW). VEW is a serverless self-service platform that lets our engineers launch secure, cloud-based development environments on demand. You will run and extend it, and work with our engineering teams to bring automotive toolchains such as MATLAB/Simulink, AUTOSAR tooling, compilers and simulators into the cloud.
Prior experience with VEW itself is not required. We are looking for strong hands-on experience with the AWS services it is built on.
Responsibilities:
Deploy, operate and evolve the VEW backend using infrastructure as code
Maintain the self-service catalog of virtual workstations (Amazon DCV) and engineering environments
Automate the AMI lifecycle for engineering toolchains
Integrate VEW with identity (Microsoft Entra ID), license servers and code repositories
Build CI/CD pipelines for the platform and for the teams that use it
Work with our platform engineers to manage floating licenses for specialized tools

Skills & Experience required:
5+ years building and operating production workloads on AWS
Infrastructure as code: AWS CDK, Terraform or similar
Serverless on AWS: Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, EventBridge
Python
AWS multi-account setup and security: Organizations, IAM, cross-account access, VPC networking
Identity federation with Amazon Cognito and an enterprise identity provider (Entra ID / Active Directory)
AWS Service Catalog and EC2 Image Builder (or Packer)
CI/CD with GitHub Actions or AWS CodePipeline
You have prior work experience from the automotive industry
Degree in SW/IT or similar
Fluent in English is a must and Swedish is a plus

A plus if you have:
Hands-on experience with AWS Virtual Engineering Workbench
Automotive industry background
Packaging R&D toolchains (MATLAB/Simulink, AUTOSAR, cross-compilers) into AMIs or containers
FlexNet/FlexLM or other floating-license server administration
SIL test pipelines, and connecting cloud pipelines to HIL rigs
Virtual ECUs, vehicle environment models, or MBSE tooling
Amazon DCV, Windows and Linux image hardening

Softskills:
You are flexible and pro-active and driven
You are communicative and can easily create a network
You enjoy teamwork and working cross-functionally

Amazon is seeking a student to join its core consumer business team, working on projects to expand product selection, drive demand, optimize the supply chain, enhance customer experience, and improve processes. Read more below and apply today!
About the role
As a working student, you will be assigned a mentor to support you in your work. In addition to learning about a significant project, you will have the opportunity to interact with Amazon employees for both personal and professional development. You will also be able to expand your network and participate in activities with other working students to learn about the advertising portfolio or commerce services and Amazon culture.
Work tasks
Understand customer challenges, requirements, and potential value that can be delivered through advertising or commerce services
Identify opportunities to improve products, services, processes, systems, and tools
Identify goals through market data and industry intelligence
Analyze and extract insights from data using Excel and SQL
Develop/manage homepage content, campaigns, events, etc
Present your work to stakeholders at all levels

We are looking for
Language: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, as the language is used daily
Education: Currently studying at least 50% at a university or college in logistics, business administration or technology, with at least one year remaining in your studies
Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, charts)

It is meritorious if you have:
Skills: Experience in similar roles and/or knowledge of SQL. 
Language: Knowledge in Swedish, Polish, Dutch, and French.

To succeed in the role, you have the following personal characteristics:
Communicative
Meticulous
Analytical

A thorough background check will be conducted prior to any potential employment.
Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.
